proof_system.trusted_setup: IPA - NO trusted setup required. This is a fundamental difference from the on-chain branch (KZG needs an SRS) and from Groth16 (needs a per-circuit ceremony).

solidity.note: Read from artifacts/build-info - the settings solc ACTUALLY used, not copied from hardhat.config.js.

chain.startup_command: ganache --wallet.mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk" --wallet.totalAccounts 501
chain.hardfork: Ganache default - must match the evmVersion above
chain.gas_is_a_counted_quantity: Gas is fixed by the EVM specification, NOT by the client => it carries over to mainnet as long as the hardfork matches. Wall-clock time does NOT carry over.
chain.opcodes_used_by_this_system: SLOAD, SSTORE, CALL, STATICCALL, memory, calldata - their prices last changed at Berlin/London, both BEFORE paris. Shanghai and Cancun only ADD opcodes; they do not reprice existing ones => these gas figures still hold on today's mainnet.

verifier_contract.note: MECHANISM DOES NOT EXIST - the off-chain branch has no verifier contract. This cell must stay EMPTY in the paper, never 0 (0 reads as 'free to deploy' and hides the real price: the contract cannot verify the proof itself).

withdraw_calldata.note: D7 definition: 4-byte selector + all ABI-encoded arguments. ADV sends no proof on chain, hence NO dynamic argument - which is simultaneously the gain (tiny calldata) and the loss (the contract cannot verify anything; it trusts the university).

whole_system.consists_of: deploy_pool_gas (ADV has no verifier to deploy)

block_gas.note: block_gas_limit is an ASSUMPTION about mainnet (30M), not a measurement. The gas figures are real measurements on Ganache. `withdraw` is a RECURRING per-transaction cost; `whole_system` is a ONE-TIME cost - two different questions.

bytecode_vs_deploy_gas.g_codedeposit_source: Ethereum Yellow Paper - an EVM constant, not a measurement

pool.remainder_consists_of: 21 000 base transaction + 32 000 contract creation + calldata for the creation bytecode (~13-16 gas/byte) + constructor execution

bytecode_vs_deploy_gas.note: Bytecode size and deploy gas are TWO VIEWS of one thing: bytes answer 'is it allowed on chain at all' (EIP-170), gas answers 'how much does it cost'.
